From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 06 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Snapshot runbook and data provenance check for Q3 readout

Team —

We need a tight evidence pack and a short runbook for the Q3 readout that will go to the board next week. High level asks (please own items where indicated):

- Metric extracts (raw CSV + short note on filters/segmentations) — owner: Neha — deliver by EOD today.
- Calculation runbook (one-page per KPI: formula, inputs, last updated) — owner: Mina — deliver tomorrow morning.
- Data provenance snippet (sources, refresh cadence, known caveats) — request Jonas to own appendix 2.
- Appendix mapping doc (who owns which slide & fallback reviewer) — I'll assemble but need confirmations.

I've attached the initial snapshot_outline.docx with the suggested appendix breakdown and a proposed one-pager template. Keep the evidence pack minimal — we want reproducible artifacts (extracts + mapping doc) rather than narrative text.

Please flag anything that requires legal or security input (cc'ing Olga for the gate). If you hit a blocker with exports or permissions ping me and I'll escalate.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Operations, Redwood Inference

Marissa —

Quick update:
- Metric extracts: attached metric_extracts_q3.zip (includes daily and weekly rollups for revenue, inference tokens, and API error rates). Each CSV has a small README with the extraction query and the time window used.
- Filters documented inline; note a small mismatch in tokenization between the serving logs and billing logs (see mapping_notes.pdf).

 blockers: two legacy buckets require cross-account access; I raised infra ticket QBR-512 — ETA for creds is tomorrow morning. If the creds are delayed I can provide the aggregated extracts but not the row-level event logs.

Also attached mapping_notes.pdf with the initial column map and a short note on the tokenization caveat (important for any per-token cost calculations).

Neha
Neha Kapoor
Director, Revenue Analytics

Folks —

Consolidating the thread and next steps for distribution to the investor board:

1) Evidence pack (final): metric_extracts_q3.zip (Neha) + mapping_notes.pdf (Neha) + calculation runbook (Mina) + data provenance appendix (Jonas). Please upload the final files to the Drive folder linked below by 11:00 AM PT tomorrow.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cQBR-SNAPSHOT-ROOT
JIRA: QBR-512 (infra ticket for creds)

2) Legal/Security gate: Olga — please confirm there are no PII/third-party license concerns. If you need a call, we can do a 30-minute sweep tomorrow 9:00 AM PT.

3) Comms one-pager: Mina, use the qbr_communication_plan.pdf template attached and keep it to one page. Audience: board + lead investors (Diane included).

4) Delivery plan: I'll do a final pass on the appendix mapping and produce the one-slide summary for the board deck. If anyone needs a dry-run with me or Diane, ping to schedule.

Attaching: qbr_communication_plan.pdf (template)

Thanks all — appreciate the fast turnaround on this.

Marissa
